analysis_set.span: For the primary endpoint the Full Analysis Set was used. This included all patients who were randomized to study treatment. Patients were analyzed according to their randomized treatment assignment.

follow_up.span: Over a median of 2.4 years, a primary outcome event occurred

entry_age.span: Female or male aged ≥18 years at the time of consent

notes: The primary endpoint analysis includes all randomized patients by assigned treatment, supporting ITT. Registry primary-outcome time frame: up to 38.2 months; quoted follow-up is the reported median. Entry restrictions narrow the adult CKD population without placing it outside the question. No held_local full-text source was included; findings use only the supplied abstract and registry texts.
